description: Bornes de recharge pour is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de communes Pays Haut Val d'Alzette. Location of charging stations for electric vehicles deployed on roads and in car parks in the territory of the CCPHVA. Find the interactive map of charging stations on. Coverage: Communauté de communes Pays Haut Val d'Alzette. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations for electric vehicles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de communes Pays Haut Val d'Alzette. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-03-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
